## Purpose

Describe the controlled change and the affected company/business-line scope.

## Fact-state impact

- [ ] No corporate fact changes
- [ ] LOCKED / PROVISIONAL / OPEN / SUPERSEDED canon updated through the decision process
- [ ] MODEL_PROPOSED / SCENARIO_INPUT / SYNTHETIC_INSTANCE / DERIVED data only

## Affected surfaces

- [ ] Canon / governance
- [ ] Business-line dossier or unit registry
- [ ] Brand / collateral
- [ ] Organization chart / briefing
- [ ] Database / migration / query
- [ ] Finance / workbook / release package
- [ ] Wiki source

## Validation

- [ ] `python scripts/validate_enterprise_structure.py`
- [ ] organization and brand validators
- [ ] applicable lint, type, unit, integration, reconciliation, and public-safety tests
- [ ] generated artifacts reviewed and checksummed when applicable

## Publication and safety

- [ ] No credentials, hidden benchmark truth, private NAILEX implementation, or unreleased scenario answers
- [ ] Generated outputs are CI/release artifacts rather than mutable source-tree duplicates
- [ ] README, affected dossier pages, registry, and wiki source agree

## Remaining limitations

List unresolved items explicitly. Do not use “complete” or “integration-ready” beyond the tested acceptance boundary.
